item.title: LHS Episode #606: A New Beginning
item.description: Hello and welcome to the 606th installment of Linux in the Ham Shack. In this episode we discuss K5TUX Russ becoming a silent key, the future of the podcast, and a few topics of interest (Age Gating Linux, Open Hamclock Backend, and more). We look forward to getting back on a weekly cadence and we'll see you in Xenia, OH at Hamvention in May! 73 de LHS Team
